changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: One row per section per quarter (issue #363), many to one budget: the enrollment estimate and its source, and the UCSB API's enrollment and max enrollment as a cache with when they were last checked. Fills it from the non-removed recruitment_courses rows: a section in both the TA and the ULA recruitment gets the higher of the two estimates (decided by the maintainer; if only one is set, that one; a recruitment_courses row never recorded a source, so the source is null), the checked time is the latest Populate of its recruitments, and a quarter with courses but no budget row yet gets one at zero. Then drops enrollment, max_enroll and enrollment_estimate from recruitment_courses. Roll back with liquibase rollback-count 1: the three columns come back, every recruitment row of a section gets the quarter's values, and the table is dropped.

sql.comment: A quarter whose recruitments have courses but that was never budgeted gets its budget row, at zero and the default conversion factor, so the course rows have a parent.
sql.sql: INSERT INTO budgets (quarter) SELECT DISTINCT r.quarter FROM recruitments r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recruitment_courses rc WHERE rc.recruitment_id = r.id AND rc.removed = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budgets b WHERE b.quarter = r.quarter)

sql.comment: One row per quarter and enroll code over the non-removed recruitment rows. MAX ignores nulls, so a section in both recruitments gets the higher estimate, and the one estimate when only one is set.
sql.sql: INSERT INTO budget_courses (quarter, enroll_code, course_id, section, enrollment, max_enroll, enrollment_refreshed_at, enrollment_estimate, enrollment_estimate_source) SELECT r.quarter, rc.enroll_code, MIN(rc.course_id), MIN(rc.section), MAX(rc.enrollment), MAX(rc.max_enroll), MAX(r.last_populated_at), MAX(rc.enrollment_estimate), NULL FROM recruitment_courses rc JOIN recruitments r ON r.id = rc.recruitment_id WHERE rc.removed = FALSE GROUP BY r.quarter, rc.enroll_code

UPDATE recruitment_courses SET enrollment = (SELECT bc.enrollment FROM budget_courses bc JOIN recruitments r ON r.quarter = bc.quarter WHERE r.id = recruitment_courses.recruitment_id AND bc.enroll_code = recruitment_courses.enroll_code), max_enroll = (SELECT bc.max_enroll FROM budget_courses bc JOIN recruitments r ON r.quarter = bc.quarter WHERE r.id = recruitment_courses.recruitment_id AND bc.enroll_code = recruitment_courses.enroll_code), enrollment_estimate = (SELECT bc.enrollment_estimate FROM budget_courses bc JOIN recruitments r ON r.quarter = bc.quarter WHERE r.id = recruitment_courses.recruitment_id AND bc.enroll_code = recruitment_courses.enroll_code)
